meta.scope: Ecuador batch 4 — Education satellite accounts, health/social security (IESS), household income & expenditure (ENIGHUR), NBI poverty, and deeper fiscal/social-protection anchors. Final expansion pass.

candidates.title: Cuentas Satélite de Educación (CSE)
candidates.description: Satellite accounts of education measuring the value added, expenditure and production of the education sector (public and private). Complements the national accounts with a sectoral view of education.
candidates.notes: 2024 education VAB ~5.5% of GDP (USD 6.8 bn). Higher education is the largest single industry within the satellite. Links the education budget to the real-side accounts.

candidates.title: Encuesta Nacional de Ingresos y Gastos de los Hogares (ENIGHUR)
candidates.description: Periodic household income and expenditure survey. Updates the structure of household consumption, provides the weights for the IPC, and supports living-conditions and inequality analysis.
candidates.notes: Structural survey (latest 2024-2025 after a 12-year gap). Average monthly household income ~USD 1,135; expenditure ~USD 930. Directly feeds the IPC basket and complements ENEMDU on the expenditure side.

candidates.title: Pobreza por Necesidades Básicas Insatisfechas (NBI)
candidates.description: Structural poverty indicator based on unsatisfied basic needs (housing quality, overcrowding, access to services, education, economic dependence). Calculated primarily from census data and updated with survey information.
candidates.notes: Complementary structural poverty measure to income poverty. 2022 census: 39.8% of the population with at least one NBI. Provincial extremes remain large (Amazonian provinces highest).

candidates.title: Instituto Ecuatoriano de Seguridad Social (IESS) — coverage and finances
candidates.description: Main social-security institution covering pensions, health insurance and other benefits for formal workers and their dependents. Major fiscal counterpart and health-system actor.
candidates.notes: Central social-protection node. Large and growing claims on the national budget (state contribution to pensions and health). Continuously cited in fiscal and health-system analysis; historical arrears are a recurring policy issue.

candidates.title: Sistema de salud pública / Ministry of Health statistics
candidates.description: Public-health service statistics, coverage indicators and related expenditure. Complements IESS and household-survey health modules.
candidates.notes: Public provider side of the dual health system (MSP + IESS). Linked to the health functional budget and to household access indicators from ENEMDU/ENIGHUR.

candidates.title: Gasto público en educación
candidates.publisher: Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas / INEC CSE
candidates.description: Public expenditure on education as reflected in the national budget and in the education satellite accounts.
candidates.notes: Education is a constitutionally prioritised function. CSE and budget execution together track the resource side of the education system.

candidates.title: Gasto público en salud y seguridad social
candidates.publisher: Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas / IESS
candidates.description: Public expenditure on health and social security, including the state contribution to IESS pensions and health benefits.
candidates.notes: Health and social-security spending are major and growing budget items. The state–IESS financing relationship is a structural fiscal issue under dollarization.

candidates.title: Encuesta Nacional sobre Desnutrición Infantil (ENDI)
candidates.description: Specialised survey on child malnutrition, early childhood development and related household conditions. Complements the broader health and living-conditions system.
candidates.notes: High-priority social indicator survey. Tracks chronic malnutrition and early-childhood development outcomes; used for targeted social-policy monitoring.

candidates.title: Provincia de Tungurahua — low-poverty highland contrast
candidates.description: Highland province with among the lowest income-poverty rates in the 2025 results. Completes the low-poverty set alongside Pichincha.
candidates.notes: 2025 income poverty ~11%. Useful as a second low-poverty highland node.

candidates.title: Provincia de Manabí — large coastal province
candidates.description: Major coastal province with elevated poverty and a large absolute number of poor households. Completes the coastal provincial set alongside Guayas.
candidates.notes: Significant coastal population and poverty mass. Frequently appears in both absolute and relative poverty rankings.

proposed_edges.basis: The education satellite accounts are a sectoral extension of the national accounts.
ENIGHUR provides the expenditure weights for the IPC basket.
NBI is calculated primarily from census housing, education and service variables.
IESS health and pension benefits are a major component of public social expenditure.
Education is a major functional allocation in the national budget.
Health and social-security spending are major functional allocations in the national budget.
ENDI provides specialised early-childhood nutrition and development indicators that complement broader health statistics.
